title: Billing a payer does not make a billable work order internal
custom_preconds:
BLOCKED ON RELEASE: this test checks Bill To on internal and No Charge work orders, which needs Internal Work Orders (SV-11665), not released yet. Do not run it now. It can be tested once SV-11665 is released.

Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, a billable customer that bills itself.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, a billable payer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Approved, that bills itself.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Expand the Customer card.
  3. Click the Bill To field.
  4. Pick customer B in the list.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A as a billable work order.

Step 2:

  • The Customer card shows a "Bill To" field under Authorizer, reading "This customer".

Step 3:

  • The list opens.

Step 4:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer B's name.
  • Work order 1 is still billable: only customer A decides whether it is internal.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12317 (Story 15, Internal and No Charge work orders)

  • S15-R5: “The customer alone decides whether a work order is internal; the Bill To never does.”
  • Story 15, Dependency: “Dependency: applies when Internal Work Orders (SV-11665) ships; rules from its PRD (Confluence 942243841).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
